title: REQ · Pure grid drawing helpers and a declared-size registry exist
summary: Pure drawing helpers and a registry of declared sizes for room art
description: Context: sources.ts builds grids from character maps only. Desired behavior: pure helper functions create a grid, fill and outline rectangles, apply ramp shading and dither, and map ramp name and step to a PALETTE index. A registry declares width and height for every room art id. Expected result: later grids are built from these helpers against declared sizes. Why: one shared toolkit keeps outlines and shading consistent and testable.
acceptance_criteria: Given createGrid(w,h,idx), when called, then it returns an h-row by w-column grid of idx
Given rampIndex('wood',2), when called, then it returns the PALETTE index of PALETTE_RAMPS.wood[2]
Given ROOM_ART_SIZES, when read, then it has an entry with positive integer width and height for each of the 13 room ids
technical_constraints: Shared palette is defined once in src/lib/palette.ts and only referenced
Pure functions, no I/O or randomness
definition_of_done: Helpers and registry exported and typed
